searchBoundary: Primary papers, official institutional copies, and official datasets were searched for common-horizon battery degradation, varying-condition lifetime prediction, degradation-mode validation, and path-dependent ageing. Similarity does not establish novelty.

sources.title: Data from: Lithium-ion battery degradation: comprehensive cycle ageing data and analysis for commercial 21700 cells
sources.usedFor: Official 40-cell source, file hashes, experiment metadata, processed performance summaries, and the RPT0/RPT8 comparison.
sources.doesNotEstablish: The record does not supply a common EOL event for all 40 cells and therefore cannot by itself validate RUL or cycle life.

sources.title: Lithium-ion battery degradation: Comprehensive cycle ageing data and analysis for commercial 21700 cells
sources.usedFor: Primary experimental design, 15 operating conditions, GITT and degradation-mode definitions, and the statement that RPT8 is common to all cells.
sources.doesNotEstablish: The paper reports descriptive degradation trajectories rather than the preregistered held-regime three-arm prediction test.

sources.title: The importance of degradation mode analysis in parameterising lifetime prediction models of lithium-ion battery degradation
sources.usedFor: Evidence that capacity and resistance can fit multiple incompatible mechanism models and that electrode-resolved degradation modes add a stricter validation axis.
sources.doesNotEstablish: It does not show that BoL DMA quantities predict later degradation in unseen SoC/protocol regimes.

sources.title: Predicting battery lifetime under varying usage conditions from early aging data
sources.usedFor: Primary precedent for separating condition-level and cell-level features under varying usage and for using reference-test differential features.
sources.doesNotEstablish: Its 225-cell hierarchy and feature construction are not an independent held-experiment test of the Imperial BoL passport.

sources.title: Degradation path indicators for lithium-ion batteries
sources.usedFor: Primary evidence that capacity fade, pulse resistance, and degradation modes form distinct path-indicator spaces across 48 cells and 24 stress combinations.
sources.doesNotEstablish: Unsupervised path clustering does not prove prospective transfer of a BoL passport to a held usage regime or to EOL.

sources.title: Degradation path prediction of lithium-ion batteries under dynamic operating sequences
sources.usedFor: Primary precedent that future internal degradation paths depend on both current diagnostic state and anticipated operating sequence.
sources.doesNotEstablish: Its dynamic-sequence model is not a held-regime BoL-only comparison and does not remove the need for independent common-EOL validation.

sources.title: Limits of electrochemical data for predicting battery lifetime and failure
sources.usedFor: Current boundary analysis motivating tests that distinguish predictive electrochemical proxies from unobserved local defects and mechanical thresholds.
sources.doesNotEstablish: A perspective identifies limits and candidate modalities but does not adjudicate the present dataset.

noveltyStatement: RC53 does not claim a new algorithm. Its contribution is the falsifiable combination of a zero-influence schema pilot, complete experiment holdouts, three nested diagnostic arms, a common uncensored horizon, and an explicit refusal to relabel that horizon as lifetime. A prior-art search found related components but did not establish that this exact adjudication has been published.
